get_lite_config: get the config dictionary for the AlphaStar standard lite architecture
customize_encoder_settings: customize the encoder settings for game loop, unit counts, player, and MMR in the lite config
modify_torso_parameters: modify the torso parameters including vector resnet, units transformer, scatter, and visual resnet blocks
adjust_head_configurations: adjust the head configurations for function, delay, queued, repeat, unit tags, target unit tag, and world heads
configure_stream_sizes: configure the vector, units, and visual stream sizes for the lite architecture
